description: This file defines the SortOption class, which encapsulates a sorting configuration comprising a SortFieldExpression and a SortDirection. It includes constructors, getters, and overrides for equals, hashCode, and toString methods.

classes.name: SortOption
classes.description: Immutable class representing a sort option with a field expression and a direction.

methods.name: SortOption
methods.description: Constructor initializing a SortOption with a specific SortFieldExpression and SortDirection.

methods.name: getSortExpression
methods.description: Returns the SortFieldExpression associated with this sort option.

methods.name: getSortDirection
methods.description: Returns the SortDirection associated with this sort option.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides the default equals method to compare SortOption objects based on their contents.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides hashCode to produce a hash based on sortExpression and sortDirection.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the SortOption object.
